name: Historic Centre of the Town of Diamantina
description: Diamantina is a colonial town in the mountains of Minas Gerais, Brazil, built on the wealth of the 18th-century diamond rush. Its steep cobbled streets, whitewashed houses with brightly painted window frames, and baroque churches sit in a rugged, rocky landscape that once seemed hostile to settlement. Walking its old centre shows how prospectors turned a remote highland into a town of real beauty.
